title: Infant formula, Gerber Good Start Soy, Stage 1, powder, made with bottled water (375)

content.title: About
content.content: Gerber Good Start Soy Stage 1 is a soy‑based infant formula designed for babies from birth to 6 months (Stage 1). The powder is reconstituted with water, in this case bottled water, ensuring purity and consistent composition. The formula provides plant protein, DHA, ARA, prebiotics and essential vitamins needed for growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Suitable for infants who need a soy alternative to cow’s milk.
Contains DHA and ARA – fatty acids that support brain and eye development.
Prebiotics in the formula help promote a healthy gut microbiome.
Each container yields multiple servings, making it convenient for travel.
Gerber Good Start Soy has undergone clinical testing for safety and tolerance in infants.

items.title: Supports brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA are critical components for the formation of neural tissue and visual system.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Soy protein is hypoallergenic and generally well tolerated by infants with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, D and zinc help strengthen the infant’s immune defenses.

items.title: Promotes healthy gut flora
items.content: Prebiotic fructooligosaccharides stimulate the growth of beneficial bacteria in the intestine.

items.title: Provides energy
items.content: The formula supplies carbohydrates and fats needed for growth and activity.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Some infants may develop an allergic reaction to soy proteins; discontinue use at the first sign of symptoms.

items.title: Not suitable for phenylketonuria
items.content: The formula contains phenylalanine, so it must not be given to children with PKU.

items.title: Proper reconstitution required
items.content: Incorrect water‑to‑powder ratio can lead to dehydration or nutrient excess.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Keep the opened container in a dry place and use within the stated period; otherwise taste and safety may deteriorate.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Use clean bottled water warmed to about 37 °C (body temperature). Add the measured amount of powder (usually 1 scoop per 30 ml of water), mix thoroughly until smooth. Prepare the feed immediately and do not leave it at room temperature for more than 1 hour.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry powder in its original sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 30 days. Do not keep prepared formula at room temperature for longer than 1 hour.
